Figure 8: Zero-shot accuracy versus KL divergence across task categories for different model architectures and sizes. Accuracy remains stable until KL divergence exceeds approximately 0.01: distribution-lossless (DL) compression implies task-lossless (TL) compression, but TL can be achieved at lower bitwidths since benchmarks are less sensitive than distributional metrics. Larger models tolerate greater distributional shift before degradation. The x-axis uses logarithmic scale.
